name: Love in the Japari Park
source:
Japari Park is an incredible place, many games and most importantly: Friends!
A young caregiver is in charge of 3 beautiful Friends, the park rules say that humans and Friends cannot be more than friends, but the relationship of our caregiver with his girls can reach more.
translation:
加帕里公园是一个令人难以置信的地方，有很多比赛，最重要的是：朋友们！
一个年轻的看护者负责照顾3个美丽的朋友，公园规则说人类和朋友不能超过朋友，但我们的看护者和他的女孩们的关系可以达到更多。
